claims.quote: This packet contains fallible location distributions for red and blue over 4x4 local grids at nodes n0n3 in panels p0 and p1.
claims.reason: Packet includes distributions for roles 'red' and 'blue' in panels p0/p1 and coordinate_system rows=4, columns=4.

claims.quote: Current estimates: in both panels node n0 is uniform for both roles.
claims.reason: current entries for panel p0/p1 node n0 show uniform distributions (all 0.0625) for blue and red.

claims.quote: Nodes n1 and n2 in both panels show complementary partial-column concentration:
claims.reason: current derived.red_blue_peak_relation for nodes n1/n2 in both panels indicate complementary column-concentrated peaks.

claims.quote: blue peaks in the right two columns of the top two rows
claims.reason: current derived.peaks for node n1 in both panels list blue peaks [[0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]] (right two columns, top two rows).

claims.quote: blue peaks in the right two columns of the top two rows
claims.reason: current derived.peaks for node n2 in both panels list blue peaks [[0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]] (left columns), contradicting the quoted placement.

claims.quote: red peaks in the left two columns of the top two rows
claims.reason: current derived.peaks for node n1 in both panels list red peaks [[0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]] (left two columns, top two rows).

claims.quote: red peaks in the left two columns of the top two rows
claims.reason: current derived.peaks for node n2 in both panels list red peaks [[0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]] (right columns), contradicting the quoted placement.
derived.peaks for nodes n1 and n2 in both panels list four cells per role.

claims.quote: In panel p0 current node n3, blue peaks at cell [1,2]
claims.reason: panel p0 current node n3 derived.blue.peaks = [[1,2]].
panel p0 current node n3 derived.red.peaks = [[0,1]].

claims.quote: In panel p1 current node n3 is uniform.
claims.reason: panel p1 current node n3 distributions are uniform (all 0.0625).

claims.quote: Conditional candidate records vary: some candidates leave distributions like the current ones,
claims.reason: candidate entries across panels include cases identical to current distributions for several nodes (e.g. many candidate k0/k1/k2 nodes match current patterns).

claims.quote: while others shift panel p1 node n3  e.g. candidate k0 concentrates blue on the right half of the top two rows and red on the left half;
claims.reason: panel p1 candidate k0 node n3 derived.blue.peaks = [[0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]] and derived.red.peaks = [[0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]].

claims.quote: candidate k1 or k2 concentrate blue at [1,2] and red at [0,1],
claims.reason: panel p1 candidate k1 derived.blue.peaks = [[1,2]] and derived.red.peaks = [[0,1]].

claims.quote: candidate k1 or k2 concentrate blue at [1,2] and red at [0,1],
claims.reason: panel p1 candidate k2 derived.blue.peaks = [[1,2]] and derived.red.peaks = [[0,1]].
panel p1 candidate k2 peak_probability values (blue 0.99988776, red 0.99744695) exceed candidate k1's (blue 0.99171978, red 0.89771259).

claims.quote: Copied or inherited records are not new measurements;
claims.reason: Packet lists origin kinds 'copied_prior_record' and 'inherited_current', but the packet does not supply an explicit semantic statement that these are not new measurements.

claims.quote: conditional command records are hypothetical estimates, not executed events.
claims.reason: packet.candidate_semantics = "conditional supplied record or estimate, not an executed branch" and origin kinds include 'command_estimate', matching this statement.
